title: Empowering Consumers in Green Transition - Business Requirements

sections.purpose_scope: Define business capabilities, seller attribute inputs, buyer eco-trust disclosures, and automated green claim verification across EU surfaces to achieve full compliance with Directive 2024/1799.

customer_requirements.text: Buyers must view verified eco-badges and official certification issuer links on View Item pages.
customer_requirements.rationale: Direct fulfillment of Article 3(1)(a) mandate for verifiable environmental claims.

customer_requirements.text: Block sellers from submitting generic climate-neutral claims without accredited EU verification.
customer_requirements.rationale: Fulfillment of Article 3(1)(b) prohibition on offset-based climate claims.

customer_requirements.text: Display standardized EU commercial durability guarantee notices on listing pages and checkout.
customer_requirements.rationale: Fulfillment of Article 4(2) harmonised disclosure mandate.

customer_requirements.text: Provide seller attribute input for Repairability Index Score (1.0 to 10.0 scale) and spare parts availability.
customer_requirements.rationale: Fulfillment of Article 4(3) repairability disclosure mandate.

customer_requirements.text: Require seller input for software update support duration (in months/years) for smart devices.
customer_requirements.rationale: Fulfillment of Article 6(1) digital product update disclosure.

business_requirements.text: Automate real-time green claim keyword scanning in seller listing titles and descriptions during listing flow.
business_requirements.rationale: Prevent non-compliant seller listings from publishing on EU sites.

sections.out_of_scope: Non-EU seller listings shipping exclusively to non-EU buyers outside EU jurisdiction.

risk_decisions.context: Automated listing suppression vs warning state for existing listings with unverified green keywords.
risk_decisions.decision: Apply warning banner to sellers during 6-month grace period before executing hard listing blocks.
